name: Paulo Do Nascimento Cabral-Draft Council decision
title: RECOMMENDATION on the draft Council decision on the conclusion, on behalf of the European Union, of the Protocol (2024-2029) implementing the Fisheries Partnership Agreement between the European Community and the Republic of Cabo Verde
part_text:
The European Parliament agrees to a new five-year fishing deal between the EU and Cabo Verde. EU boats may catch 7,000 tonnes of tuna and similar fish in Cabo Verde's waters each year. In return, the EU pays 780,000 euros a year: 350,000 for fishing access and 430,000 to help develop Cabo Verde's own fishing sector. The deal also covers better working conditions, scientific support, protection of the marine environment and action against illegal fishing.

- EU boats get access to Cabo Verde waters for tuna fishing until 2029.
- Cabo Verde receives 3.9 million euros over five years, partly for its fishing industry.
- The Council can now formally conclude the agreement.
